name: LayersPanel
description: Glass UX tree with thumbnails, drag reorder, Alt+Arrow reorder, F2 rename, row menus and masks.

props.name: busy
props.description: Disable asynchronous conflicting edits while baking or importing.

props.name: canMask
props.description: Which layers can take a mask. Default: image layers.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: Initial selection for uncontrolled use.

props.name: error
props.description: Reports an operational error to the host.

props.name: kindIcons
props.description: Icons for host-registered layer kinds.

props.name: layers
props.description: Plain layer values in compositing order.

props.name: onAddImage
props.description: Host opens a file chooser; absent hides the action.

props.name: onAddMask
props.description: Add a mask. Absent adds it through `onLayersChange`.

props.name: onApplyMask
props.description: Bake a mask into its layer's pixels. Absent hides the action.

props.name: onDeleteMask
props.description: Delete a mask with its strokes. Absent removes it through `onLayersChange`.

props.name: onDuplicate
props.description: Copy a layer with what belongs to it, such as its strokes. Absent copies the layer alone.

props.name: onFlatten
props.description: Bake the visible picture to a single base with no editable layers. Absent hides the action.

props.name: onLayersChange
props.description: Reports a complete list and a translated history label.

props.name: onMaskEnabledChange
props.description: Turn a mask on or off. Absent changes it through `onLayersChange`.

props.name: onMergeDown
props.description: Bake the selected layer with the one below. Absent hides the action.

props.name: onPaintTargetChange
props.description: Reports a new paint target, from the choice or a click on a thumbnail.

props.name: onPasteImage
props.description: Host reads its clipboard; absent hides the action.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Delete a layer with what belongs to it. Absent removes the layer alone.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.description: Reports selection without changing the layer data.

props.name: paintTarget
props.description: Whether the selected layer's pixels or mask take strokes. Absent hides the choice.

props.name: renderThumbnail
props.description: Draw a layer's or its mask's thumbnail. Absent shows the kind's icon and a mask glyph.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Controlled selection, or undefined for local selection.
